title: MIHVER Publication Broker Client Request (wire shape)
description: Machine-readable shape of the single message the unprivileged Publication Broker client Unix socket accepts (tools/publication-broker/internal/server.packageWireRequest is the canonical Go implementation). Carries the four PublicationPackage components base64-encoded so they survive JSON transport unmodified; the Broker re-derives the REQUEST DIGEST from the decoded raw bytes -- this wire envelope itself carries no digest field, since trusting a client-supplied digest would defeat the point of recomputing it. See docs/development/PUBLICATION_BROKER.md's 'PublicationPackage / Request Digest' section for the semantic recipe, and schemas/dev/publication-envelope.schema.json, schemas/dev/publication-receipt.schema.json, and schemas/dev/publication-package-manifest.schema.json for the shape of the three JSON components once decoded.

envelope_b64.description: Base64 (standard encoding) of the exact raw PublicationEnvelope JSON bytes.

receipt_b64.description: Base64 (standard encoding) of the exact raw PublicationReceipt JSON bytes.

bundle_b64.description: Base64 (standard encoding) of the exact raw self-contained Git bundle bytes.

manifest_b64.description: Base64 (standard encoding) of the exact raw publication-package-manifest.schema.json JSON bytes.
